This review summarises the platform details published on that site.

Immediate GP at a Glance

According to the site, the platform analyses Bitcoin, Ethereum, Litecoin, and other order books, applies machine-learning models to spot price patterns, and executes automated trades. It cites indicators such as RSI and MACD and on-chain metrics like transaction volumes.

The dashboard is responsive, works on desktop and mobile browsers, and needs no app download.

Risk Controls and Tracking

Users can set maximum position size as a percentage of account equity, define stop-loss distance in basis points, and pause automated trading with one toggle.

The dashboard shows open positions with USD valuations, daily percentage change, and a timestamped trade history for tax reporting and review.

Registration in Three Steps

1. Submit details

Complete the secure form; the site says it confirms U.S. residency eligibility within one business day.

2. Configure with a specialist

Choose crypto pairs, set the initial deposit, and define risk tolerance before any capital is committed.

3. Fund and activate

Fund by bank transfer or crypto, review the dashboard walkthrough, and switch on automated trading.

Start With Immediate Path AI

Costs and Deposits

The site does not publish a fixed minimum deposit or a fee schedule. The initial deposit is chosen during onboarding, so confirm figures with the onboarding specialist.

Join Immediate Path AI

Who the Platform Targets

No prior trading experience is required, per the site, which says analysis, signals, and execution are automated while the user keeps control over risk settings.
